notes.title: v0.3.01
notes.content:
[b]New Features->[/b]
[list]
[*] New enemy types
   [i]Karl[/i]: A mighty brute that is easier to dodge, but will surely send you to Valhalla should you get caught by his axe
  [i] Seidr[/i]: Master of the flame, this enemy has the ability to throw balls of fire at you! (Fireballs can not be parried)

[*] A New Raiding Experience
   New structures
   10 villages, each one slightly more difficult to raid than the last
   Guard patrols now roam the center path. Face them head-on or avoid the path and risk navigating the wilderness
   New loot containers, including some that you can break open with a weapon!
   Added combat effects to make fighting feel more impactful

[*] Targeting Ability
   Press the target key to lock on to the enemy you are looking at (default is "R", but keybinds can be adjusted in the options menu)
   Targeting an enemy also displays their remaining health

[*] Reworked Dash Ability
   The player character is now invulnerable when dashing
   You can now dash through enemies for a quick escape
   Dashing no longer brings the player to a complete stop

[*] New Inventory System
   Items now have different sizes. Some items take up more space in your inventory than others
   Items that are not 1x1 or 2x2 in size can be rotated to fit your inventory space better
   Added tooltips to help assist with using the inventory menu

[*] New items
   Trinkets: Shiny pieces of treasure to add to your collection
   Building materials: Found in breakable crates, building materials do not take up inventory space, but instead are tracked by the counters in the top-right of the inventory menu
   Armor: Equip armor pieces to increase your protection rating (reducing damage taken) at the cost of your movement speed

[*] The storm
   The gods do not favor those who are greedy. Stay in any village too long, and you will be lost to a violent storm!
   Added an indicator to the HUD to indicate how close the storm is (Also indicates the current village number)
   Once the storm arrives, you will have a short period to find an exit before the storm takes your life. The fog will lift when the storm arrives

[*] Village Exits
   The red exit takes you to the next village, while the green exit returns you to your home and ends the current raid (using the red exit in village #10 also takes you home)
   The exits will not be available until some time after the player enters a village
   You will not be able to use the exits if you are under attack

[*] Stat Rolls
   Equip-able items all have various stats associated with them. These stats have a range, so two items of the same quality may not have the same stats.

[*] Breakable Shields
   Over-relying on shields to protect you will cause them to break. Keep an eye on their durability!

[*] Home Village Updates
   New structures, including a new keep building. Head to your throne to access your keep's inventory
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes->[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented players from adding health items to the currently equipped stack
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the game to freeze when loading a new village
[/list]

[b]Other Changes->[/b]
[list]
[*] New foliage models
[*] New UI icons
[*] Since this is a major update, all previous saves will be wiped
[/list]

Apologies for the long delay since our last playtest update. We want to give regular updates, but a lot of the changes listed above just weren't able to be released separately. We hope to get back to more frequent updates going forward.

This update has changed a lot about Jötunn's Greed as you know it. If you find the time to try it out again, please let us know your thoughts. You can find a link to our feedback & bug report forms both in-game and in our [url=https://discord.gg/FUDcKR7TdH]Discord[/url]. It really means the world to us that we get to have a community of fans playing our early builds, and we want to create the best experience for you that we can.

Enjoy!

notes.title: v0.2.01
notes.content:
Sound the horn! Take back what's yours!

This update introduces the core gameplay of Jötunn's Greed! Set sail and raid nearby villages!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993745/f59c6d913f6b2049111c8db1d77d55b2407d3332.gif[/img]

New Features ->
[list]
[*] Raids
[*] Enemies now have combo attacks
[*] Added storage to the Home Village Keep
[*] Added the ability to equip/unequip weapons, shields, and health items
[*] Added the first ultimate ability: Freya's Blessing (Heals the player to full health. Starts on cooldown)
[*] Added attack speed stat to weapons. Higher tier weapons can attack more quickly
[/list]

Bug Fixes ->
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused sound effects to stop playing after a certain period of gameplay
[*] Fixed an issue that caused weapons and shields to duplicate in the player's inventory
[*] Fixed looping door sounds
[*] Fixed an issue that would prevent loot from spawning in chests
[/list]

Other Changes ->
[list]
[*] Added sounds (footsteps, ambience, enemy alert)
[*] Added VFX
[/list]

Grab as much loot as you can and make it to the village exit without dying or you lose it all! Best of luck chief!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993745/1b9bb84bba95f9d49d71addcd3e317b3b493e835.gif[/img]

[/list]

[/list]

Thank you to everyone that has given feedback so far! Keep it coming!

notes.title: v0.0.02
notes.content:
[b]New Features ->[/b]
[list]
[*]Health Items
Press "Q" to use an item to regain some health. Each item will regenerate 50% of your max health over 5 seconds. Taking damage interrupts your health regeneration. For now you only get 3 items, so use them with caution!
[*] Combat effects
The sword now deals AoE damage when slashing or jump attacking. 
Stabbing attacks, jump attacks, and heavy attacks all interrupt an enemy's attack.
Heavy attacks have a 30% chance to stun the target for 2 seconds.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes ->[/b]
Fixed an issue that caused an enemy to turn away from the player before attacking.
Fixed an issue that caused an enemy to start a second attack before finishing their first attack.

[b]Other Changes ->[/b]
Slowed the speed of the spinning camera after saving the Home Village
Increased the height of the fog in the Home Village
Lowered the volume of music in the Home Village
